questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Enjoy the sun whiles its there. 
Get your documents from your police before you arrive. makes it easier to apply for the rifle. 
Never say no to a hike.
